Reduced numerical test weights derived from fastino/gliner2-base-v1.
Source: https://huggingface.co/fastino/gliner2-base-v1
Revision: f9634218e53580c56edf0de97ca1a7d3f1c2354e
Model card licence: Apache-2.0.
Modifications: the encoder and the relation heads sliced to width 32, as
analysis/relation/reference/gliner2/build_fixture.py records; the count
transformer's width-128 layers are copied whole. These are not production
model weights. real.json holds only outputs of the full checkpoint.
Reference outputs produced by GLiNER2 (Apache-2.0) at
ca4f68235b50fe4c3ecf3876851d748fe4b15c6c and Hugging Face Transformers
4.57.1 (Apache-2.0).
